title: SG-2.1 Author the room shell and furniture grids
summary: Author palette-indexed source grids for the room shell and every furniture piece at declared native sizes, with size and palette tests
description: Context: game/frontend/src/art/sources.ts holds only a hand cursor grid, and src/lib/gridToRgba.ts, spriteSheet.ts and generateAssets.ts already turn grids into PNGs. The room art is still SVG. Desired behavior: source grids exist for wall, wainscot, floor, window with night sky, desk, computer, lamp, plant, poster, bookshelf with books and globe, bed, door and rug, each at a declared size, drawn with outlines and ramp shading from the shared 48-colour palette in src/lib/palette.ts. Expected result: unit tests assert each grid's size and that it uses only palette colours. Why: this is the art base for SG-2.2 and SG-2.3. Switching content and manifest to PNGs and deleting SVGs is out of scope.
acceptance_criteria: Given the room source registry, when it is loaded, then it contains grids for wall, wainscot, floor, window, desk, computer, lamp, plant, poster, bookshelf, bed, door and rug
Given each source grid, when its width and height are measured, then they equal the size declared for that id
Given each source grid, when it is rendered with gridToRgba against PALETTE, then every pixel colour is a palette colour and each grid uses at least 3 distinct palette indices

in_scope: Room shell and furniture source grids with declared sizes
Unit tests for size and palette use
out_of_scope: Switching content and manifest to PNGs and deleting SVGs (SG-2.3)
preserve: Existing SVG assets and manifest entries

technical_constraints: All art is raster pixel art generated in the repo from source data by a deterministic script; no downloaded art or CDN
One native scene resolution of 480x270, whole-number scaling, nearest-neighbour
One shared palette of at most 48 colours defined once in src/lib/palette.ts
Tests are unit tests with all dependencies mocked
Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix and Zustand stay
definition_of_done: All 13 grids exist at declared sizes
non_functional: Drawing code is deterministic and pure, so output is stable between runs
